features.oracle: resolved library title and duplicate diagnostic

features.requirement: kind resolves the exact supplied-library title and is never inferred from ports.
features.oracle: resolved shape title or missing-kind diagnostic

features.requirement: Every source reference becomes exactly one directed logical edge and cycles or unknown references fail.
features.oracle: canonical edge set and validation error

features.requirement: Every generated edge endpoint equals its named visible component contact.
features.oracle: independent component-local visible geometry and endpoint coordinates

features.requirement: Any valid subset of mux inputs may be connected without changing component identity.
features.oracle: port-key validation and generated edges

features.requirement: One source port fanout uses one justified first trunk with junction semantics.
features.oracle: final route trunk x coordinates and junctions

features.requirement: An unconstrained zero-indegree node occupies its latest feasible forward layer, including middle columns.
features.oracle: independent ASAP/ALAP ranks and final x columns

features.requirement: Only zero-indegree logical sources may gain geometry-justified rendering aliases for distant consumer bands.
features.oracle: logical identity, facility partition and final alias assignments

features.requirement: Every logical edge reports length, bends, segments, crossing points/events and distinct crossed-edge count.
features.oracle: production versus independent final-geometry report

features.requirement: Every logical node including leaves reports degree, direct downstream commonality, anchors and outgoing quality totals.
features.oracle: input node key equality and aggregate sums

features.requirement: Routes reject node/label hits, avoidable global detours, dominated bends and avoidable crossings.
features.oracle: independent visibility-channel candidates and obstacle geometry
features.proves: no known dominated route in candidate family

features.requirement: Integer layout_column values constrain relative columns without numeric gaps or causal reversal.
features.oracle: topology feasibility and final rank comparisons

features.requirement: One clock occupies each row and sibling terminal ordering introduces no avoidable rightmost crossing.
features.oracle: terminal axes, parent grouping and final crossing geometry

features.requirement: Output is self-contained native SVG compatible with browser and librsvg-style static viewers and fully bounded.
features.oracle: static SVG validator, browser CTM and librsvg gate

features.requirement: Clock rows align with optional FUNC/SCAN/BIST values and all headings/values remain inside the viewBox.
features.oracle: SVG element axes, content and viewBox containment

features.requirement: Topology-derived dispatch preserves geometry through 512 to 4096-clock stress without a public maximum.
features.oracle: stress counts, hard geometry and measured runtime budgets

features.requirement: Equivalent repeated input produces normalized identical layout and SVG.
features.oracle: normalized document equality

features.requirement: Frozen and source deployments in the archive generate every documented example with isolated PATH and verified manifest.
features.oracle: archive content/hash and executable/source smoke

features.requirement: Project skills and references are complete, linked, private-free and included in the source manifest.
features.oracle: project skill validator and archive manifest

features.requirement: Every required feature role and declared risk interaction maps to real tests, fixtures and direct Oracles.
features.oracle: coverage manifest validator and deletion mutants

interactions.rationale: Parsing, merge order and exact kind resolution meet before layout.
Sparse occupancy must not move or reinterpret fixed ports.
Low-use roots move inward while a common root and its routes remain readable.
Physical aliases must remain one logical source in every statistic.
Shared trunks must not multiply crossings while different nets remain attributable.
Endpoint correctness, obstacle clearance and final artifact paths can fail independently.
Preferences and free placement must never reverse a causal edge.
A one-to-two sink group beside a one-to-one group is a known crossing interaction.
Long/empty values and the lowest row affect final export bounds.
Quality measurement must remain feasible at the largest declared stress size.
The frozen and source archive must preserve the same input surface as the repository.
Offline quality guidance and its ledger must be present and hash-bound in the archive.
